text:
maria: quick update 52 starting Ceres LoRA merge into pegasus-2x on my dev box. need a tiny smokepack (int8 + int4) focused on tokenizer remap and stop-token behavior before CS handoff.

sam: ok. remind me, did we remap the 4 custom tokens to the high-id range or keep host ids?

maria: remapped in adapter metadata (customers/ceres/token_map.json). noticed one long-form prompt truncates earlier than expected after merge. looks like tokenizer->kv ordering mismatch.

eli: can you paste the local quick run output?

maria: pasted below (local smoke, no kv cache):
```
run_id: ceres-local-2026-03-21
model: pegasus-2x + ceres-lora
quant: int8
seq_len: 512
batch: 8
results:
  rouge_l: 0.423
  ppl: 12.6
  answer_exact_match: 0.78
notes: int4 quick experiment gave rouge_l 0.401; observed stop-token drops on ~5% long prompts
```

ci-bot: created CI smoke run https://ci.redwood.ai/runs/765432 (artifacts pending).

zoe: the stop-token drop sounds like the KV-cache offset bug we saw earlier when adapter token ids were remapped but runtime used original ordering for KV slots. could be a boundary at token id 5020.

sam: to reproduce locally:
```
python -m rw_infer.eval_smoke \
  --model pegasus-2x \
  --adapter customers/ceres/ceres-lora.safetensors \
  --token-map customers/ceres/token_map.json \
  --quant int4 \
  --seq 512 \
  --no-kv-cache \
  --prompts tests/ceres/long_prompts.jsonl
```

maria: running now on dev GPU, will paste logs if it matches. if it reproduces, mitigation options: (1) force adapter to use host tokenizer ids during merge, or (2) patch runtime to realign KV offsets post-remap.

eli: reserving ded-pegasus-01 for a full int4 smoke (~25m). if clean, plan to push a canary to customer-staging with rollback to hosted-pegasus-small.

maria: CS wants a one-pager: issue, root cause hypothesis, mitigation, ETA. sam can draft.

sam: on it. ETA: canary by EOD if ded run passes.

zoe: handoff checklist:
- reproduce truncation on minimal prompt (in progress)
- tokenizer roundtrip (encode->decode->encode) vs token_map JSON
- run int8 + int4 smoke on ded cluster (batch sizes 1/8/64)
- small perf run to measure latency regressed by quant/adapt merge
- create canary route w/ fallback + monitor triggers

ci-bot: artifacts uploaded: https://ci.redwood.ai/artifacts/765432/logs.tar.gz, eval_summary.json

eli: ded run finished. int4 reproduces truncation in 2/30 prompts. excerpt: "...generated text abruptly ends at token id 5021 after remap". attaching snippet to CI.

maria: thanks. trying quick mitigation: re-merge adapter with --use-host-token-ids flag and run same smoke to compare.

sam: good plan. if that fixes it, we release patch then re-run full smokepack. also include small note in release about adapter token remap caveat.

zoe: minor note: if we force host ids we may break customers that intentionally used high-id private tokens; include token_map backup and a migration note.

maria: agreed. i'll include migration steps and recommended timeline in the shortnotes. ping @sam @eli when new run completes. :eyes:

sam: drafting shortnotes now, will include CLI commands, CI links, and rollback steps.

maria: i'll upload the prompt set and a minimal repro to the CI run shortly. closing loop later today. :thumbsup:
